from object_detector import Object_Detector_Tool

def analyze_dresser_count(image_path):
    detected_objects = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image=image_path, labels=["dresser"], save_object=False, saved_image_path="detected_objects")
    dressing_count = {}
    for label, detection in detected_objects.items():
        if label == "dresser":
            number_of_dressers = 0
            for entry in detection:
                if entry["box"][0] > 0 and entry["box"][1] > 0:
                    number_of_dressers += 1
            dressing_count[label] = number_of_dressers
    return dressing_count

final_result = analyze_dresser_count("/nfs/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/9216_0.png")
print("Total dressers in the scene:", final_result)
